crossRefs.note: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy…
So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of Yahweh.
translations.bsb: So Moses announced to the Israelites the appointed feasts of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.
translations.asv: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the set feasts of Jehovah.
